purpose: Report one frontier reader's zero-shot provenance account of a single text, using the prompts of "Frontier models need only one text to unmask its human or AI author" (arXiv:2611.26216), vendored verbatim under references/unmasking-authors-prompts/ (MIT). `--task ideas-prose` asks who originated the ideas and who wrote the prose and returns the reader's stated AI share (0-1) and label for each, with the evidence it cites; `--task which-model` returns the model and lab it names with its stated confidence. Every cited quote is checked against the target. The answer can be produced outside SETEC (`--emit-prompt`, then `--response`) or sent to an Anthropic reader through the shared judge backend (the OpenAI and Gemini backends force JSON replies, which would change the prompt). `--generator-lab` refuses a reader from a lab that wrote or edited the target. Emits no verdict and does not apply the paper's 0.5 cut; naming a human author (the paper's RQ3) is not wired.
use_when: You want an explainable second reader beside a trained detector, with quoted evidence you can check
You want to know whether a model-written or model-edited text still reads as a particular lab's model (teacher-style leakage after training)
You can run the prompt on a reader from a different lab than any model that touched the text
do_not_use_when: You need a determination about a person (misconduct, disclosure, grading); one reader's account is not evidence of that
The reader's lab wrote or edited the target (self-assessment; declare --generator-lab so it is refused)
You want to name a human author from their text (not wired; see the vendored README)

compute.cost_note: Free with --reader response (run the --emit-prompt output on any model, e.g. through a subscription CLI); one Anthropic API call per text with --reader anthropic (the paper reports about $27 per 1,000 documents on GPT-6.1 Sol)

examples.description: Render the ideas/prose prompt to run on a reader outside SETEC
Parse the saved answer, refusing an Anthropic reader for a Claude-edited draft
Ask an Anthropic API reader which model wrote an OpenAI-edited text
examples.cmd: python3 plugins/setec-voiceprint/scripts/zero_shot_provenance_read.py draft.txt --task which-model --reader anthropic --reader-model claude-fable-5-2 --generator-lab openai --json

references: Desai, Bölöni-Turgut et al., Frontier models need only one text to unmask its human or AI author (arXiv:2611.26216): https://arxiv.org/abs/2611.26216
